Tomba 2 FMV Skipping
====================

This built-in feature moves Tomba 2's existing Skip FMVs switch from generic
Display settings into Mods.

When enabled, the runtime mutes and rapidly advances streaming XA/MDEC movies.
Tomba 2's silent, RAM-preloaded Whoopee Camp logo is covered by its game-specific
MDEC detector. The game still reaches its normal end-of-movie path, preserving
completion and teardown side effects.
